Using Biomart to map ensemble gene IDs to gene symbols. 1.1 Packages library(knitr) library(dplyr) library(tibble) library(readr) library(ggplot2) library(stringr) kable_head <- function(x, n = 5, caption = NULL) { knitr::kable(utils::head(x, n), caption = caption) } strip_ensembl_version <- function(x) sub("\\..*$", "", x) source("~/projects/Megan_Ding/in_class_exercises/id_mapping/fetch_geo_supp.R")

2 Exercise 1. GSE119732 gse <- "GSE119732" fetch_geo_supp(gse = gse) path <- file.path("data", gse) files <- list.files(path, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) safe_read <- function(file) { # First attempt: read as TSV df <- tryCatch( readr::read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL # catch fatal errors ) # If read_tsv failed entirely: if (is.null(df)) { message("TSV read failed — reading as space-delimited file instead.") return(readr::read_table(file, show_col_types = FALSE)) } # If read_tsv returned but with parsing issues: probs <- problems(df) if (nrow(probs) > 0) { message("Parsing issues detected in TSV — reading as space-delimited file instead.") return(readr::read_table(file, show_col_types = FALSE)) } # If everything was fine: return(df) } x <- safe_read(files[1]) kable_head(x[, 1], 20, paste(gse,": first 20 gene ids")) Table 2.1: GSE119732 : first 20 gene ids gene_id ENSG00000223972.5 ENSG00000227232.5 ENSG00000278267.1 ENSG00000243485.4 ENSG00000237613.2 ENSG00000268020.3 ENSG00000240361.1 ENSG00000186092.4 ENSG00000238009.6 ENSG00000239945.1 ENSG00000233750.3 ENSG00000268903.1 ENSG00000269981.1 ENSG00000239906.1 ENSG00000241860.6 ENSG00000222623.1 ENSG00000241599.1 ENSG00000279928.1 ENSG00000279457.3 ENSG00000273874.1 id_col <- names(x)[1] ids <- x[[1]][1:20] |> as.character() num_dot <- sum(grepl("\\.", ids)) print(paste0("Of the first 20 gene ids, ", num_dot, " have versions.")) ## [1] "Of the first 20 gene ids, 20 have versions." if (any(grepl("^ENSG", strip_ensembl_version(ids)))) { library(biomaRt) ensembl_ids <- unique(strip_ensembl_version(ids)) ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl") map <- getBM( attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"), filters = "ensembl_gene_id", values = ensembl_ids, mart = ensembl ) kable_head(map[, c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol")], 20, paste(gse,": mapping")) } Table 2.1: GSE119732 : mapping ensembl_gene_id hgnc_symbol ENSG00000186092 OR4F5 ENSG00000222623 RNU6-1100P ENSG00000223972 DDX11L1 ENSG00000227232 WASH7P ENSG00000233750 CICP27 ENSG00000237613 FAM138A ENSG00000239906 ENSG00000239945 ENSG00000240361 OR4G11P ENSG00000241599 ENSG00000241860 ENSG00000243485 MIR1302-2HG ENSG00000268020 OR4G4P ENSG00000268903 ENSG00000269981 ENSG00000273874 MIR6859-2 ENSG00000278267 MIR6859-1 ENSG00000279457 WASH9P ENSG00000279928 DDX11L17
